---
title: "chaoticds Extreme-Value Report"
output: html_document
params:
  data_rds: ""
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
report <- readRDS(params$data_rds)
```

## Overview

- Source: `r report$source_label`
- Observations: `r report$n`
- Threshold quantile: `r report$threshold_q`
- Threshold value: `r signif(report$threshold, 6)`
- Block size: `r report$block_size`
- Run length: `r report$run_length`

## Warning Flags

```{r}
if (length(report$warnings) == 0) {
  cat("No major warning flags detected.")
} else {
  cat(paste0("- ", report$warnings, collapse = "\n"))
}
```

## Time Series and Threshold

```{r}
plot(report$series, type = "l", col = "gray40",
     xlab = "Time", ylab = "Value",
     main = "Series with POT Threshold")
abline(h = report$threshold, col = "red", lty = 2, lwd = 2)
```

## Block Maxima

```{r}
hist(report$block_maxima, breaks = 20, col = "lightblue", border = "white",
     main = "Block Maxima Distribution", xlab = "Block maximum")
```

## Exceedances

```{r}
hist(report$exceedances, breaks = 20, col = "mistyrose", border = "white",
     main = "Exceedances Above Threshold", xlab = "Exceedance value")
```

## Extremal Index

```{r}
ei <- c(runs = report$theta_runs, intervals = report$theta_intervals)
print(ei)
```

## Cluster Summary

```{r}
print(report$cluster_summary)
if (length(report$cluster_sizes) > 0) {
  hist(report$cluster_sizes, breaks = 15, col = "thistle", border = "white",
       main = "Cluster Size Distribution", xlab = "Cluster size")
}
```

## Threshold Diagnostics

```{r}
print(head(report$diagnostics$mrl, 10))
print(head(report$diagnostics$hill, 10))
```

## Model Fits

### GEV Fit
```{r}
print(report$gev_fit)
```

### GPD Fit
```{r}
print(report$gpd_fit)
```
